name: Void Dreaming
source:
You are Rael. Freshly removed from events that have shattered your life, you’re left adrift and alone. Stranded on the backwater Yakeshi Station at the fringe of galactic society, all that you are is staked on one last chance to make amends and set your life back on course. One opportunity, with everything on the line.

Through Zuberi, captain of the Astrogation Guild deep-space exploration vessel Void Dreamer, you have that chance. Board his ship, join an eclectic crew all there for various reasons of their own, and explore the mysterious outer edges of the galaxy as you try to put yourself back together.

Just be careful. Fringe space is far from safe, and the darkness between distant stars holds secrets more deadly and more powerful than you can possibly imagine.

[From [URL=https://faorameridian.itch.io/void-dreaming]itch.io[/URL]]
